name: Music Mix
description: A long-form music channel. There is no script and no narration: the episode is a mix built from the channel's own music library, under one looping background. Pick ONE world and keep it — the picture is the brand, and a channel that changes worlds is a playlist nobody recognises. Vary the setting, colour and weather instead; every video gets its own background.
exampleTopics: Rain on the window — 1 hour to study to
Slow surf at golden hour — 2 hours

musicFormat.note: Everything below is DATA. Add a world, edit a scene, change the music styles — no code change is needed, and a new pack of worlds is a product you can sell. The PRESENCE of this object is what marks the formula as a music format; `kind` is reserved by the content-pack system and always reads 'series-formula'.

worlds.name: Rain Window Desk

worlds.name: Attic Bedroom
worlds.sight: Sloped ceiling, fairy lights along the beam, a record player turning in the corner.

worlds.name: Cat on the Radiator

worlds.name: Ramen Counter at Night

worlds.name: Balcony Above the City

worlds.name: Train Window Seat

worlds.name: Greenhouse Corner

worlds.name: Still Water at Dusk

worlds.name: Forest Floor After Rain

worlds.name: Birch Grove in Snow

worlds.name: Lake Cabin Dock

worlds.name: Tea Field Hillside

worlds.name: Riverbank Willows

worlds.name: Desert Bloom at Dusk

worlds.name: Moss and Stone Stream

worlds.name: Wheat Field in Wind
worlds.sight: Gold moving in one direction, a low sun behind it, a single distant tree.

worlds.name: Vast Coast
worlds.sight: A cliff edge, slow surf a long way below, and an enormous sky doing almost nothing.

worlds.name: Peaks Above Cloud

worlds.name: Glacier Face

worlds.name: Storm Over Plains
worlds.sight: A wall of weather crossing flat country, lightning far enough away to be silent.

worlds.name: Cathedral Interior

worlds.name: Dunes at Dawn
worlds.sight: Ridge after ridge to the horizon, one side lit and the other in deep shadow.

worlds.name: Northern Fjord
worlds.sight: Sheer walls dropping into black water, the far end lost in weather.

worlds.name: Volcanic Coastline
worlds.sight: Black rock against white spray, no soft edges anywhere in the frame.

worlds.name: Salt Flat Mirror
worlds.sight: A thin film of water turning the whole plain into sky, with no horizon line at all.

worlds.name: Redwood Cathedral
worlds.sight: Looking straight up impossible trunks into green, with fog moving between them.

worlds.name: Floating Islands
worlds.sight: Land drifting in open sky, waterfalls pouring off the edges into nothing.

worlds.name: Endless Library
worlds.sight: Stairs and galleries continuing past where they could reasonably go, warm lamps at every level.

worlds.name: Whale in the Sky
worlds.sight: Something enormous moving slowly above a small town, casting a shadow across the roofs.

worlds.sight: The sea overhead like a ceiling, light coming down through it, dry ground below.

worlds.name: Giant Moon Over Rooftops

worlds.name: Door in a Field
worlds.sight: A freestanding doorway in open grass, standing open, showing somewhere that isn't the field.

worlds.sight: A fifties neon VACANCY sign, one car, the sea flat and pink behind the building.

worlds.name: Grandmother's Kitchen

worlds.name: Ferry Deck at Dawn
worlds.sight: Old painted wood and brass rails, a harbour going past, everything damp.

worlds.name: Record Shop Aisle
worlds.sight: Crates at browsing height, handwritten dividers, posters curling off the wall.
